fields.label: Our FFL Licence Number
fields.description: This store's FFL. A web order naming it as the receiving FFL is treated as in-store pickup.

fields.label: Alert Recipients
fields.description: Emails (comma or newline separated) that receive operational alerts. Empty = all System Managers.

fields.label: Receive Sources
fields.default:
RSR
Distributor
Individual (trade-in)
Manufacturer
Consignment
Other
fields.description: One per line; fills the Source dropdown on Receive Goods, FFL Acquisition and Purchase Receipt.

fields.label: Pending Order overdue after (days)
fields.description: A queue row older than this is marked overdue on Pending Order and listed in the managers' daily digest.

fields.label: Receipt Footer Note
fields.description: Plain text printed under every receipt, one line per line. Empty prints nothing.

fields.label: Shipping Price Includes Sales Tax
fields.description: On: when an order is taxed, the shipping you enter is what the customer pays, with the sales tax already inside it, and the receipt says "sales tax included". Off: sales tax is added on top of the shipping. Only affects new orders; an existing order keeps the way it was created.

fields.label: Lock Idle Screen After (minutes)
fields.description: After this long with no touch or key, a counter screen locks and shows the staff list: the same person unlocks with their password, or another signs in. 0 = never.

fields.label: Gunsmith Labor Item
fields.description: The service item a work order's labor is billed on (default GUNSMITHING). Its own Item Tax Template decides whether labor is taxed — in some states repair labor is taxable, in others separately stated labor is not; ask your accountant.

fields.label: Intake Authorization
fields.description: The Per document agreement the customer signs for a work order (default Gunsmithing Authorization).

fields.label: Paper 4473 Mode
fields.description: 4473 and NICS are handled on paper outside this system; the counter records a Paper 4473 instead of calling FastBound.

fields.label: Transfer Fee Item
fields.description: Service item charged for a customer transfer-in 4473.

fields.label: Default Transfer Fee
fields.description: Default per-firearm fee added to a Transfer ticket; editable per sale.

fields.label: Store Customer ID Numbers
fields.description: Keep ID numbers and dates of birth on customer records; turning this off erases the stored numbers and dates of birth, while attached ID copies, change history and deleted records are kept.

fields.label: Provider
fields.options:
ATF Form Scraper
Data Service
Manual Only
fields.description: Where live FFL verification is looked up. Data Service uses the connection on Data Service Settings; Manual Only disables it.

fields.label: Rate Limit (req/hr)
fields.description: Maximum ATF Form Scraper requests per hour.

fields.label: Cache TTL (minutes)
fields.description: How long a verification result is reused before it is looked up again.
